nodes.name: Emergency Power Load Shed
nodes.text: Shed non-essential loads. Priority order: science instruments, Tier 2 compute, heating pads, lighting. Maintain life support and comms.

nodes.name: Vehicle Safe Mode Entry
nodes.text: Shed all non-essential loads. Point solar arrays at Sun. Maintain minimum attitude control. Await crew assessment or ground command.
